collection.title: Mercedes-Benz A Class Saloon 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz A Class Saloon 2018 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Mercedes-Benz wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
